name: GUN BLAZE
source:
The events of this game take place in London, in the second half of the 19th century. Mark Flint is a young private detective. One day he sees several men assault a young girl near his apartment. He saves the girl, only to discover that he has seen her face already on a wanted poster. But the girl (whose name is Jewel) explains that she is being hunted by the mysterious society of Rosenkreuz. Her father was a great scientist who knew how to make items out of pure ether; his zeppelin was attacked, and the Rosenkreuz are after the ether-made necklace Jewel is wearing. Mark, Jewel, and their friends have to find a way to defeat the Rosenkreuz and their leader, the ambitious Irene, who won't stop until the entire world is under her control...

[From[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/44267/gunblaze/] MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
该游戏的事件发生在19世纪下半叶的伦敦。马克·弗林特是一位年轻的私家侦探。有一天，他看到几个男人在他的公寓附近袭击了一名年轻女孩。他救了女孩，却发现他已经在通缉海报上看到了她的脸。但女孩（名叫朱厄尔）解释说，她正在被神秘的罗森克鲁兹社团追捕。她的父亲是一位伟大的科学家，知道如何用纯乙醚制造物品。他的齐柏林飞艇遭到攻击，而罗森克鲁兹家族正在寻找朱厄尔佩戴的以太项链。马克、朱厄尔和他们的朋友们必须找到一种方法来击败罗森克鲁兹家族和他们的领袖、雄心勃勃的艾琳，而艾琳在整个世界都在她的控制之下之前不会停止……
